description: Somos un grupo de estudiantes guiado por una de nuestras docentes, estamos  interesados en aprender, crear ideas y buscar soluciones a problemas de nuestro entorno. Nos interesan temas como el cuidado del medio ambiente, las energìas renovables y el bienestar de nuestra comunidad. Nosotros queremos aprovechar esta oportunidad para aprender cosas nuevas, trabajar en equipo y aportar nuestro granito de arena para construir un futuro mejor.
summary: We, The Stones, created this to explore how places on Earth can help us understand the Moon and Mars. Our bilingual website focuses on Timanfaya in Spain, Campo de Piedra Pómez in Argentina, and the Qaidam Basin in China. We brought together maps, photographs, geological comparisons, a simulator, and a quiz so visitors can explore the similarities for themselves. We also explain where these comparisons fall short, since Earth and other planets are not the same. With this project, we wanted to make the research easier to understand and show why studying these landscapes matters for space exploration.
details: We developed a JavaScript web page with AI assistance (Claude & ChatGPT), which allows us to learn how terrestrial analogs improve research and testing for explorations on other celestial bodies such as Mars and the Moon. Using the NASA resources provided to us, we searched for three locations on Earth that share environmental characteristics with the Moon and Mars, and analyzed how these places are potential candidates for future research that can help upcoming expeditions toward them. We ensured that the site features a simple and concise interface keeping all necessary information at hand, and that the locations we chose truly share similarities with the planets, making them useful for the project and for research.
